data.spec: Actual USB /dev/cu.usbmodem101 read verified on Noah machine: sensor keys co2_co2=987ppm, co2_temperature~29.8C, co2_humidity~21%, aht20_temperature~29C, aht20_humidity~24%, distance_sensor_min_distance=32767 sentinel. Fix metric_for broad 'co2' substring: it misclassifies auxiliary temperature/humidity as CO2. Use explicit alias map co2_co2→co2_ppm; co2_temperature/aht20_temperature→temperature_c; co2_humidity/aht20_humidity→humidity_pct; unknown quantities rejected. No route shape change. Will update local feature code + PR5 before physical threshold test. No firmware flashing.
